response.sql: WITH rep_counts AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), city_averages AS (SELECT City, AVG(customer_count) AS city_average FROM rep_counts GROUP BY City), overall_total AS (SELECT SUM(customer_count) AS customer_total FROM rep_counts) SELECT r.City AS city, SUM(r.customer_count) AS total_customers, AVG(r.customer_count - a.city_average) AS average_above_city_average, AVG(r.customer_count * 1.0 / o.customer_total) AS average_share_of_overall_customers FROM rep_counts r JOIN city_averages a ON r.City IS a.City CROSS JOIN overall_total o WHERE r.customer_count > a.city_average GROUP BY r.City;
